sources.title_zh: Penguin Mail——一款适用于 Linux 的开源 Rust 电子邮件客户端，支持人工智能
sources.title_original: Penguin Mail——一款适用于 Linux 的开源 Rust 电子邮件客户端，支持人工智能
sources.summary:
Gmail, Microsoft and any IMAP or POP3 account, with your calendar and contacts, in one fast app on your own computer.
Gmail, Microsoft and any IMAP or POP3 account, with your calendar and contacts, in one fast app on your own computer.
Mail and calendar for Linux
Gmail, Microsoft and any IMAP or POP3 account, with your calendar and contacts, in one fast app on your own computer.
Version 1.0.0. Free software under GPL-3.0-or-later, for x86_64 Linux.
Sign in to Gmail, to Outlook.com, Hotmail, Live
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Penguin Mail 是 x86_64 Linux 上的开源 Rust 邮件客户端，以 GPL-3.0-or-later 发布，能聚合 Gmail、Microsoft、IMAP/POP3 账户；其 AI 默认关闭，可经 LM Studio 或 Ollama 本地运行，按 Ctrl+J 可查哪些已发邮件仍待回复。
